name: WrenAI
description: Open GenBI engine that gives coding agents a governed semantic layer so they can write correct SQL and build dashboards over 20+ data sources.
whatItDoes: Gives data teams a way to let AI agents answer business questions against warehouses and databases with consistent metric definitions. The agent produces governed SQL and dashboards rather than guessing at raw tables.
howItWorks: A semantic model (MDL) describes entities, relationships and metrics, and a query engine built on Apache DataFusion translates and runs queries across connectors. It is installed as a Python package plus agent skills, then driven from an existing coding agent or any MCP client by asking it to set up a data source.

requirements.name: Coding agent or MCP client
requirements.description: Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Codex or similar host that drives the skills

requirements.name: Data source
requirements.description: A supported database or warehouse to connect

models: Whatever model the host coding agent uses
